period_note: SOLO / STANDALONE basis (the report also contains a Consolidated version including two subsidiaries, Islami Bank Securities Ltd and Islami Bank Capital Management Ltd, which is not used here per this dataset's solo-preferred convention). Source is a scanned/signed copy with no text layer; extracted via tesseract OCR and cross-validated internally: balance sheet ties exactly (total liabilities 1,614,470,034,575 + equity 65,320,692,157 = total assets 1,679,790,726,732, an exact match; the 5 deposit sub-lines sum to the deposits total within BDT 1; paid-up capital + statutory reserve + other reserves + retained earnings sum to equity within BDT 1; total liabilities is independently reproduced from its own components -- placement + deposits + Mudaraba Bond + other liabilities + deferred tax -- within BDT 1), and the P&L ties exactly (operating income and expense sub-lines sum exactly to their totals; PBT 2,634,491,497 minus 'Provision for taxation for the period' 1,948,454,754 alone reproduces PAT 686,036,744 within BDT 1). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2022 (the filing's own column header reads '01 January to March 2022'); for Q1 this is identical to the discrete quarter. 'Provision for taxation for the period' is the bank's full tax charge; the separately-printed 'Deferred tax' line (39,972,205) is a memo sub-component of it, not an additional deduction. The liabilities section lists 'Perpetual bond' (11,000,000,000) and 'Redeemable Subordinated Bond' (20,600,000,000), which sum exactly to the parent 'Mudaraba Bond' (31,600,000,000), so the parent is counted once in subordinated_mudaraba_bond and total_liabilities, not additively on top -- confirmed by the balance-sheet identity only closing when counted once. This interim filing does NOT disclose the absolute Classified Investment balance -- only Note 11.1 'Provision for un-classified, classified investment and Off-balance sheet items' discloses the PROVISION held and its movement, included below as supplementary fields; classified_loans and npl_pct are therefore left out rather than estimated. Note 11.1's comparative column is the full prior year (FY2021), not the prior quarter. Note 11.1's 'D. Provision made during the period' total was OCR'd with its leading digits dropped (printed as '01,920,000'); it is corrected here to 2,201,920,000, cross-validated two ways: (1) the sum of its own three sub-items (Unclassified -126,050,000 + Classified 2,058,270,000 + Off-Balance-Sheet 269,700,000 = 2,201,920,000), and (2) an exact match to the P&L's own 'Provision for investments & off-balance sheet items' line (2,201,920,000) for the same period. All other Note 11.1 figures (opening, closing, and the classified-addition sub-item) are directly legible and internally consistent (opening + addition = closing for every sub-item, and A/C/E each reconcile from their own sub-items).
